GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths 3 Wide over-racing, Moved Up Two Wide Outside Lead at 1050m, held together much same to turn 1 length Two Wide , Dropped Out in Straight # Wide early/weakened

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Went Straight back from the gate Settled Down last couple Two Wide 9-10 Lengths (800m), coming up Wide out approaching Turn , clearly deepest for home I'd say 6 wide, swept Clear late finishing far too well # from last!

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced wide without cover throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down Mid Field 5 Lengths 3 Wide , Moved Up to 2 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Four Wide rounding turn and Five Wide Straightening Up , ran on hitting Lead at 150m and kept going to post # Wide run/solid+
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, brushed hindquarters, badly unbalancing its Rdr.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths , Clear last off slow start 11 Lengths 700m, worked off fence before the corner but in traffic, Made Some Ground last 200m without threatening # Never Likely

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly, laid out first turn & Settled Down 5 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to 6 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Dropped Out in straight. [Stewards: Post-race vet exam revealed a slow recovery and mild heat stress.] # wide/weakened badly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Leaving the 1300m, was inclined to lay out round first turn. Raced wide throughout. A post race vet exam revealed a slow recovery and mild heat stress.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 2 Lengths and Settled Down 11 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 12 Lengths turning, Hooked Out Wide Straightening Up and Made Good Ground in straight. GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Buffeted on jumping then inconvenienced (-1 length) and Settled Down 6 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 8 Lengths Two Wide turning, hooked widest rounding turn, out past centre of track Straightening Up , ran on solidly down the outside hitting the Lead 60m from post, kept going to line. (Blinkers FIRST TIME) [Stewards: Laid out 1100m turn when racing keenly.] # back/ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Buffeted between runners at the start and then inconvenienced and lost ground. Near the 400m was bumped and became unbalanced. Shifted wider leaving the 400m and raced very wide round home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped fairly. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield 3 Wide With Cover (5L from lead). Improved 1 length midrace & pushed to quicken @ 650m. Pushed out Four Wide @ 500m & chasing Six Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & worked home OK in last 150m. # Best work last 150m
No rush from the gate went back & settled down last couple Two Wide 10 Lengths (800m), wider & closer midrace, cornered for home widest 5 lengths or So away, peaked Soon After # run ended 200
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced wide for the majority.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly missing start 1 length and Settled Down 4.5 Lengths on fence, little change to 5 Lengths rail turning, hung out home turn and Wide Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in Straight # slow start no help
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and lost ground. Hung out round home turn.
